records.title: Reliable Evaluation Protocol for Low-Precision Retrieval
records.reason: It is an evaluation-protocol contribution, not a retrieval acceleration or LLM inference optimization; its connection to this survey is limited to evaluating low-precision retrieval components.

records.title: A Scalable Multi-LLM Collaboration System with Retrieval-based Selection and Exploration-Exploitation-Driven Enhancement
records.reason: The primary optimization target is response quality and system scalability; it does not show reduced aggregate calls, latency, or cost, and aggregation can add inference work.

records.title: ixi-GEN: Efficient Industrial sLLMs through Domain Adaptive Continual Pretraining
records.reason: The paper studies domain-adaptive continual pretraining for small industrial LLMs. Its contribution is training/domain adaptation rather than an inference-time efficiency method.

records.title: PaceLLM: Brain-Inspired Large Language Models for Long-Context Understanding
records.reason: The primary results establish long-context capability, not lower inference compute, memory, or latency; its efficiency fit is therefore uncertain.

records.title: When Slower Isn't Truer: Inverse Scaling Law of Truthfulness in Multimodal Reasoning
records.reason: The paper studies truthfulness behavior in multimodal reasoning models and does not propose an efficiency method.
